_about: Hand-checked corrections, applied last (they win over every source and recording). spm: replaces an npc/object's map spots (uiMap -> [x, y, ...] in 0-1000). qg / qe: extra quest givers / enders. note: a short tip shown by questing addons. pre: prerequisite quests (any one of them) when the data has none. races: who can take a quest (race mask, 0 = everyone).

note.c257001: Stands in a rickety murloc hut next to three murlocs around a fire. Respawns in about 3 minutes.
note.c259988: Gorgegut only offers Step One: Rock after the whole chain that starts with Rise Up!: Rise Up!, Death to the Executioner, Twilight No More!, Spread the Word and Land of Giants.
note.c7996: Qiaga the Keeper (Jintha'Alor, Hinterlands) drops the Sacred Mallet. Use it at the altar at the top of Jintha'Alor (59, 77) to get the Mallet of Zul'Farrak - it rings the gong in Zul'Farrak that summons Gahz'rilla.
